description: Land Acquisition - Ipalawa, Ibbagamuwa D/S Division, Kurunegala District - Amend to the Extra Ordinary Gazette No. 2244/09 of 07.09.2021 D/S Division, Naula
categorisation: This gazette content is exclusively about land acquisition matters under the Land Acquisition Act. It provides detailed descriptions of specific land parcels being acquired by the State for the Kurunegala-Habarana Railway Project, including lot numbers, land names, descriptions, claimants, and exact measurements. This fits perfectly within the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) which covers "land acquisitions, transfers, or disposals" and "any gazette content primarily dealing with land, property, or real estate matters."
